title: Northbeam TechWorks Scheduling Charges: Slot-Move Fees a Contract Does Not Leave
content:
How much of the fee for moving the slot is added to a business contract relief on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job turns on whether a write-off on the retailer's own error stands against that fee.

**Where such a fee stands on the job and no write-off on the retailer's own error stands against it**, that fee is added in full.

**Where such a fee stands on the job and a write-off on the retailer's own error stands against it**, what is left of that fee after that write-off is added, never below nothing.

**Where neither situation holds**, nothing of the fee for moving the slot is added.

## The readings side by side

| A fee for moving the slot stands on the job | A write-off on the retailer's own error stands on it | Added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | none | that fee in full |
| yes | at least one | what is left of that fee after that write-off |
| no | either | nothing |

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts below are chosen for the illustration and are not figures of any job on file.*

**No slot-move fee at all.** Nothing is added.

**A slot-move fee more than covered by such a write-off.** A hypothetical job carries a fee of 64.00 USD for moving the slot and 80.00 USD written off on the retailer's own error. What is left of the fee is nothing, so nothing is added.

**A slot-move fee partly written off on the retailer's error.** The same fee with 25.60 USD written off on that ground: what is left is 38.40 USD, and that is what is added.

**A slot-move fee with nothing written off on the retailer's error.** The first reading governs and the whole 64.00 USD is added.
